Proposition
[L-Jacobi comparison inequality] Source: cao-zhu 1. Proposition 3.2.3\group Cao–Zhu Comparison Theorems for Perelman’s Reduced Volume Given any unit vector $Y$ at any point $q \in M$ with $ au = ar{ au }$, consider an $\mathcal{L}$-shortest geodesic $\gamma $ connecting $p$ to $q$ and extend $Y$ along $\gamma $ by solving the ODE $(3.2.8)$. Then the Hessian of the $\mathcal{L}$-distance function $L$ on $M$ with $ au = ar{ au }$ satisfies \[ { m Hess}_L(Y,Y)\leq rac{1}{\sqrt{ ar{ au }}}-2\sqrt{ ar{ au }}\Ric (Y,Y) -\int _0^{ ar{ au }}\sqrt{{ au }}Q(X,Y)d au \] in the sense of distributions, where egin{align*} Q(X,Y)& = - abla _Y abla _YR-2\langle R(Y,X)Y,X angle -4 abla _X \Ric (Y,Y)+4 abla _Y \Ric (Y,X)\ & \quad -2\Ric _ au (Y,Y)+2|\Ric (Y,\cdot )|^2- rac{1}{ au }\Ric (Y,Y) \end{align*} is the Li-Yau-Hamilton quadratic. Moreover the equality holds if and only if the vector field $Y( au ), au \in [0, ar{ au }]$, is an $\mathcal{L}$-Jacobian field $($i.e., $Y$ is the derivative of a variation of $\gamma $ by $\mathcal{L}$-geodesics$)$.\index{$\mathcal {L}$-Jacobian field}

Proof

↗ lem:cz-second-variation-of-l-length \sketch Insert the prescribed comparison field into the second variation and use the index-form minimizing property; equality characterizes $\mathcal L$-Jacobi fields.

□
